note: Evidence-graded map of interventions to the facial/skin metrics they measurably move. Grades are Attia-style: A = strong RCT/meta-analysis with a measurable facial endpoint; B = real but heterogeneous or transient; C = weak/single small study; D = no measurable effect (we say so and refuse to attribute metric change to it).

tretinoin.label: Topical tretinoin (retinoid)
tretinoin.note: Meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=1361): significant wrinkle/texture/pigment improvement; visible ~1 month, durable to 24 months.

azelaic_acid.label: Azelaic acid 15-20%
azelaic_acid.note: Tyrosinase inhibitor; 20% azelaic ~ comparable to 4% hydroquinone for melasma in RCTs, and safe in skin of color with low irritant-PIH risk. First-line for pigment-prone skin. Heterogeneous formulations -> grade B.
azelaic_acid.source: Azelaic acid melasma RCTs / skin-of-color reviews

tranexamic_acid.label: Tranexamic acid (topical / oral)
tranexamic_acid.note: Targets the vascular/plasmin driver of melasma. Oral TXA has the strongest meta-analytic support but needs a clinician (clotting-risk screen); topical is milder. Real but route-dependent -> grade B.

niacinamide.label: Niacinamide 4-5%
niacinamide.note: Blocks melanosome transfer to keratinocytes and supports the skin barrier; split-face RCTs show reduced hyperpigmentation and improved evenness. Well tolerated -> good for reactive/dry skin.
niacinamide.source: Niacinamide hyperpigmentation split-face RCTs (Hakozaki 2002 et al.)

sunscreen_daily.label: Daily broad-spectrum sunscreen
sunscreen_daily.note: Hughes 2013 RCT (n=903, 4.5y): 24% less photoaging. PREVENTS accumulation; does not reverse existing damage.

weight_change.label: Weight change (within a healthy range)
weight_change.note: Just-noticeable facial-adiposity change ~2.38 kg/m^2 BMI (women) / 2.59 (men) ~ 14/18 lb. Reveals existing bone structure; does not change bone.

vitamin_c_topical.label: Topical vitamin C
vitamin_c_topical.note: ~52% less UVB erythema; collagen I/III mRNA +25%/+21% in a split-face RCT. Downgraded for formulation heterogeneity (concentration/pH/vehicle).

moisturizer.label: Moisturizer / hydration
moisturizer.note: Real but TRANSIENT: corneometry effect lasts hours to ~24h, not durable structure. Timestamp any hydration/fine-line metric vs last application.

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.note: Perceptual cue is strong (others rate sleep-deprived faces as more tired = grade A), but the OBJECTIVE measure is weak/high-variance: an n=181 RCT found no measured periorbital/skin-color change. High day-to-day swing; do not chase.

facial_exercise.label: Facial exercises
facial_exercise.note: One small uncontrolled study (~3 years younger perceived, enhanced cheek fullness). Weak but non-zero.

mewing.label: Mewing / tongue posture (adults)
mewing.note: NO measurable effect on adult facial structure. Adult facial bone is set; the AAO cautions there is no clinical evidence. Caliper will not attribute any jaw-metric wiggle to mewing — it would be manufacturing a false success story.

filler_botox.label: Dermal filler / botulinum toxin (clinical)
filler_botox.note: Clinical procedure requiring a provider. Evidence Level I-II including skin of color; combination beats toxin alone. Track its effect; it is not self-administered.
